question: In the year 2022, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare announced a National Suicide Prevention Strategy to reduce suicide mortality rate by ________ percent by 2030.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** announced the **National Suicide Prevention Strategy** in **2022** with the aim of reducing the suicide mortality rate by **10% by 2030.**
 
• Suicide is a major public health concern in India, with the country accounting for **17.8% of global suicide deaths **in 2019.
 
• The National Suicide Prevention Strategy aims to address the risk factors associated with suicide, such as** mental health issues, substance abuse, and social isolation,** through a multi-sectoral approach involving healthcare, education, and community-based interventions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suicide prevention** is a priority area for the government of India, and several initiatives have been launched in recent years to address this issue.
 
• These include the establishment of a **national helpline, training of healthcare professionals** in suicide prevention, and **community-based interventions.**
 
• The** World Health Organization** (WHO) states that although suicide is a major public health concern in India, it can be avoided with **prompt, evidence-based interventions.**
 
• One of the** Sustainable Development Goals (SDG3.4.2)** of the UN asks member nations to strive toward a **one-third reduction** in suicide rates worldwide by the year** 2030.**
 
• Suicide prevention is one of these goals.
 
• The** Mental HealthCare Act of 2017's** decriminalization of suicide and the establishment of India's first mental health toll-free helpline, **KIRAN**, are notable actions taken by the Indian government.​
